ns2:section.sectionText: Gaga/Dancers classes offer a creative framework for dancers to connect to their bodies and imaginations, increase their physical awareness, improve their flexibility and stamina, and experience the pleasure of movement in a welcoming, accepting environment. Every class is composed by a series of multi-layered tasks that are worked through 75 minutes in continuous movement.
